name: bollinger_ema_sar_slope_study_v1
purpose: Replace only the overly restrictive lateral/trend interpretation from Bollinger EMA SAR V1 while holding every other rule fixed.

fixed_rules.signal_patterns: rocket rejection with wick >=70% of body OR body engulfing
fixed_rules.entry: next 1m bar open after fully closed signal candle
fixed_rules.stop: low/high of candle immediately before signal candle
fixed_rules.exit: 40% of Bollinger bandwidth or close after maximum 3 bars
fixed_rules.ny_anchor: context only, never a hard session gate

slope_variants.strict3_baseline: EMA20 must rise/fall on each of the last three closed one-bar transitions. Reproduces V1 baseline.
slope_variants.directional3: LONG if EMA20_now > EMA20_3_bars_ago; SHORT if EMA20_now < EMA20_3_bars_ago. No monotonic path requirement.
slope_variants.bbnorm_2p5: directional3 plus absolute 3-bar EMA20 displacement >= 2.5% of current Bollinger bandwidth.
slope_variants.bbnorm_5: directional3 plus absolute 3-bar EMA20 displacement >= 5% of current Bollinger bandwidth.

selection_rule: Discovery only. Compare trade count, expectancy, PF, drawdown, target/stop/time exits, direction, market and session. Do not promote solely on best return. A candidate slope definition must materially improve sample size while preserving a coherent non-sideways interpretation; it still requires later confirmatory validation.
anti_overfit: No parameter search beyond these four preregistered definitions. No changes to Bollinger, SAR, EMA crossing, structure, signal candle, stop, target or holding period in this experiment.
